fact_pattern.text: By a final decree dated 21/05/2000, entered in Partition Case bearing No.7268/P of District Court of Nugegoda Kamal Gunatilleke was allotted all that allotment of land marked Lot 1 depicted in Partition Plan No.2372 dated 15/06/1998 made by.A.W. Silva Licensed Surveyor of land called Kandawatta bearing Assessment No.15, Kandawatta Road, Nugegoda containing in extent 14 Perches. He was married to Thilaka Gunatilleke and had 3 children namely Pethum, Kalum and Shanthi. Kamal Gunatilleke upon Deed of Gift No.232 dated 02/08/2002 attested by A.C. Sisira Notary Public gifted said Lot 1 depicted in the said Plan No.2372 unto to the eldest son Pethum as an absolute and irrevocable gift subject to life interest of him and his wife Thilaka. Kamal Gunatilleke died on 07/07/2005. Kamal had two children named Sadun and Nadun by his first wife Kanthi. Pethum died intestate and issueless on 08/06/2010 leaving his wife Sadana. Sadun married to Roshini and died intestate on 02/08/2011 leaving one child named Rohan. Rohan met with an accident and died on 03/10/2018 unmarried and issueless.
